mapper.select: SELECT M.CO_CD, M.REQ_NO, M.REQ_ID, NVL((SELECT U.NAME FROM TB_CM06M01 U WHERE U.ID = M.REQ_ID), M.REQ_NM) AS REQ_NM, M.DEPT_ID, NVL(M.DEPT_NM, (SELECT DEPT_NM FROM TB_CM04M01 WHERE DEPT_ID = M.DEPT_ID)) AS DEPT_NM, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(M.HOLIDAY_DT, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS HOLIDAY_DT, M.HOLIDAY_DT AS RAW_HOLIDAY_DT, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(NVL(NULLIF(M.ST_TM, ''), '0000'), 'HH24MI'), 'HH24:MI') AS ST_TM, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(NVL(NULLIF(M.ED_TM, ''), '0000'), 'HH24MI'), 'HH24:MI') AS ED_TM, M.ST_TM AS RAW_ST_TM, M.ED_TM AS RAW_ED_TM, M.SPECIAL_REASON, CASE WHEN M.REAL_ST_TM IS NOT NULL AND M.REAL_ST_TM != '' THEN CASE WHEN INSTR(M.REAL_ST_TM, ':') > 0 THEN M.REAL_ST_TM WHEN LENGTH(M.REAL_ST_TM) = 4 THEN SUBSTR(M.REAL_ST_TM, 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(M.REAL_ST_TM, 3, 2) ELSE M.REAL_ST_TM END ELSE NULL END AS REAL_ST_TM, CASE WHEN M.REAL_ED_TM IS NOT NULL AND M.REAL_ED_TM != '' THEN CASE WHEN INSTR(M.REAL_ED_TM, ':') > 0 THEN M.REAL_ED_TM WHEN LENGTH(M.REAL_ED_TM) = 4 THEN SUBSTR(M.REAL_ED_TM, 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(M.REAL_ED_TM, 3, 2) ELSE M.REAL_ED_TM END ELSE NULL END AS REAL_ED_TM, M.REAL_ST_TM AS RAW_REAL_ST_TM, M.REAL_ED_TM AS RAW_REAL_ED_TM, M.WORK_RESULT, M.REQ_MNG_OPN, M.RESULT_MNG_OPN, AS REQ_STATUS, AS RESULT_STATUS, M.CREAT_ID, TO_CHAR(M.CREAT_DTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREAT_DTTM FROM TB_PM08M01 M WHERE M.CO_CD = #{coCd} AND M.REQ_NO = #{reqNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PM08M01 ( CO_CD, REQ_NO, REQ_ID, REQ_NM, DEPT_ID, DEPT_NM, HOLIDAY_DT, ST_TM, ED_TM, SPECIAL_REASON, REAL_ST_TM, REAL_ED_TM, WORK_RESULT, REQ_STATUS, RESULT_STATUS, CREAT_ID, CREAT_DTTM, CREAT_PGM ) VALUES ( #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deptId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deptNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{holidayDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stTm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{edTm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{specialReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{realStTm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{realEdTm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workResult, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{resultStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{creatId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, 'PM0801P01' )
